notes.title: Patch 01
notes.content:
Hello,

We want to thank everyone who has shown interest and downloaded our Demo!

[b]Here is our first patch[/b]:
[list]
[*]Fixed the softlock in the warehouse
[*]Stopped monsters from running away to prevent chaos
[*]Fixed a bug in the AI
[*]Fixed a bug with the cigars
[/list]
Keep your blood running!
